accessibility: Native labeled selects/buttons, visible keyboard focus, reduced motion and320px reflow. Read priors, token/density/log contributions, normalizer, posterior, predicted class or tagged rejection/undefined reason in a numerical table plus explanation. Curves/bars are redundant; no hover/color/spatial-only meaning. Extreme float underflow is explicitly distinguished from mathematical zero.
comparison: NB combines assumed class-conditional likelihoods; existing Logistic models a linear logit. Compare on identical unseen rows and costs, not unrelated accuracy figures. No new Logistic fitting or calibration algorithm is introduced by this manifest.

configurations.counterexample: The first development label intentionally contradicts the locally favored class. Duplicating evidence can increase confidence in that wrong class. These fictional individual errors do not measure population calibration or prove every correlated feature worsens performance.
configurations.explanation: Gaussian NB fits population class variances plus one training-global epsilon. Duplicating the first feature refits a separate model and counts the same evidence twice under the independence assumption. A confident vote is not calibrated reliability; inspect the displayed held-out label and probability error.

configurations.counterexample: A predictive evidence update is not an intervention or causal quality effect. A zero supplied prior excludes a class here; all-zero evidence instead has undefined normalization.
configurations.explanation: Gaussian densities can exceed1; they are not probability masses at an exact point. Normalize prior times class-conditional density; this is supplied-density arithmetic, not a fitted estimator.
